<?php

namespace Database\Seeders;

use Illuminate\Database\Seeder;
use App\Models\User;
use App\Models\Post;
use Faker\Factory as Faker;

class RelationSeeder extends Seeder
{
    public function run()
    {
        $faker = Faker::create();

        // Create users
        for ($i = 0; $i < 10; $i++) {
            User::factory()->create();
        }

        // Create posts
        for ($i = 0; $i < 50; $i++) {
            Post::factory()->create([
                'user_id' => fake()->numberBetween(1, 10),
            ]);
        }
    }
}
```
